name: No crossover
lesson: With crossover switched off, selection still runs but every child is a copy of its parent, so only mutation can change a chromosome.
lookFor: Every pair is a bypass and no gene is inherited from a second parent. Progress comes only from the occasional ✱ flip, so it is slow: with this seed the best fitness is still 900 (11110, one gene short of the optimum 961) after 50 generations.
